terms.gloss: one of a board of ten men; mostly in the plural, decemvirī: the ten who wrote the Twelve Tables, and boards of ten for judging suits, dividing public land, and keeping the Sibylline books

phrases.latin: sedēbant jūdicēs, decemvirī vēnerant, obversābantur advocātī
phrases.english: the judges were in their seats, the decemvirs had come, the advocates were moving to and fro
